scope: Declared retained-history extension of the framed quadrilateral seed, not an unchanged native carrier.
state: Immutable shared seed and full seed carrier; current native carrier obtained by recorded rotations; full channel history from the decoded packet; supplied current mark and mesh.

F.channel: full additive Fourier in both coordinates

T.channel: translate by declared b along current marked coordinate
T.test_transpose: translate by -b along coordinate stored at execution time

laws: R H = H R for isotropic heat
R transports the marked translation axis
R^4=I on carrier; R^2=I on quadrilateral diagonal action
query_execution: Freeze coordinate-indexed instruction parameters when recording each operation, then apply test transposes in reverse chronological order to evaluate on the retained seed packet.
unmatched: Native carrier implementations of F,H,T on the full channel history
forbidden_identification: R is not F; both having order dividing four is insufficient.
